name: Heterobasidion annosum

ecology.substrate: roots and stumps of living and felled conifers

notes: Spread is set by the layout of the roots, not by the fungus: it is reported (unchecked) to have no free soil mycelium and to move through root contacts. Reported (unchecked) to be the most costly forest disease in Europe; close relatives occur in NA and AS.

tip_speed.note: Heterobasidion spread in Norway spruce: 9 cm/year in living roots, 25 in stump roots, up to 52 in stems; 25 cm/year as a year-round average. The source was not opened by the research agent

uptake_rate.note: tuning value tied to tip speed
